    """Given a list of (start_h,start_m,end_h,end_m) busy in local time on `day_date_utc`,
    compute free intervals within work window expressed in UTC.
    
    Work window local: Sep D 09:00-17:00 → in UTC, this may span different dates!
    """

    work_local_start = datetime(day_date_utc.year, day_date_utc.month, day_date_utc.day, 9, 0)
    work_local_end   = datetime(day_date_utc.year, day_date_utc.month, day_date_utc.day, 17, 0)
    
    work_utc_start = work_local_start - timedelta(hours=tz_off)
    work_utc_end   = work_local_end   - timedelta(hours=tz_off)

        b_e = datetime(day_date_utc.year, day_date_utc.month, day_date_utc.day, eh, em) - timedelta(hours=tz_off)
        busy_utc.append((b_s, b_e))
    
    # Start with the work window
